headline: Faulu Microfinance Bank Shifts Lending Focus to Small Businesses
summary: Faulu Microfinance Bank is shifting its lending strategy away from traditional retail banking toward traders and small businesses.
why: Strategic shifts in loan portfolios affect credit availability for small and medium enterprises and alter risk profiles for microfinance institutions.

impacts.name: Faulu Microfinance Bank
impacts.why: A pivot toward small business lending alters the bank's core revenue and risk generation channels.
